description: This file defines a singleton object 'PaymentPrefs' that handles persistence of the last chosen payment method in an Android application. It primarily stores and retrieves a payment method ID in shared preferences for later retrieval.

methods.name: getLastPaymentMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the last used payment method from shared preferences, returning a PaymentMethod object or null if none is stored.

methods.name: setLastPaymentMethod
methods.description: Stores the given PaymentMethod's ID into shared preferences to remember the user's last choice.
